scenes.headline: How an 8B-active model learned to keep going
scenes.sub: Laguna S 2.1: 118B total, a 1M-token context, one DGX Spark.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Harbor! Laguna S 2.1 activates eight billion parameters and fits on one desktop box. Here's how it learned to persist.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Don't add raw intelligence; train behaviors. Verify more, take less for granted, don't declare victory early, keep going.
scenes.say: The idea isn't more raw intelligence. It's better behavior: verify more, take less for granted, don't declare victory early, and keep going.

scenes.title: What post-training changed
scenes.say: It's a scale-up of Laguna XS, on the same pre-training data. Almost everything else is post-training.

items.text: RL on tasks it can't solve
items.say: Then RL, reserved for tasks it can't already solve reliably: four hundred and nine thousand environments, mostly from real commits.
Rollouts get longer timeouts, more tokens and more turns, which is likely why it keeps going.
A new sandbox blocks the network selectively, to shrink the reward-hacking surface.
And the same prompts roll out across several agent harnesses, so it learns behaviors that transfer.

left.title: Thinking off
left.say: Of every model Poolside has trained, this one gains the most from thinking.

right.title: Max thinking, the default
items: The model picks its own budget
A 1M-token context holds the working state
right.say: At max, the default, it picks its own budget. Poolside has watched productive reasoning run for hours, which is why the million-token context matters.

scenes.title: SWE-Bench Multilingual, resolved %
scenes.say: Where it leads is SWE-Bench Multilingual: seventy-eight point five, edging a much larger field.

scenes.text: How a model works is a separate axis from how smart it is, and it's trainable.
scenes.say: How a model works is a separate axis from how smart it is. And it's trainable.

recap: RL on 409k environments built from real code
Longer rollouts, a new sandbox, many harnesses
Thinking mode does real work on hard problems
scenes.say: To recap: RL on real code, long rollouts across many harnesses, and a thinking mode that earns its keep.
